summary: Willamette NF lookout site east of Detroit, Oregon: a 14x14 L-4 cab built in 1933, staffed in 1934, removed in 1967; FS trailhead page shows it closed.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1967 per the register and Rex's page; firelookout.com says destroyed that year

staffing.status: one summer lookout recorded in 1934 (Ed Schroeder, per a newspaper item); no later staffing in these sources

access.note: Forest Service trailhead page reads Site Closed, citing a closure order for the Beachie Creek and Lionshead fires; no end date is given

visit.trail_note: Triangulation Trailhead on FS Road 2233; follow Triangulation Trail about 1.5 miles to the Triangulation Peak trail junction; a hike of about 2.1 miles to the old site per a hiking site; two kinds of Mt. Jefferson Wilderness entry permit apply June 15 to October 15

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's page say the lookout was removed in 1967; firelookout.com says destroyed that year. The story uses removed, the wording in two of three sources, and reports the other.

The register says the USFS built the 1933 cab; Rex's page says the CCC constructed a 14x14 L-4 lookout house that year. The sources agree on the year and differ only on the builder, so the story credits both.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains on the summit today. The trailhead page's Site Closed status cites fires but gives no date, so it may be out of date; confirm with the Detroit Ranger District before publishing access wording. The brief's kind 'ground' is not confirmed: sources say L-4 cab or lookout house and give no height or tower. The 2010 registration date matches the brief. The register's map and 1940 and 1959 photos were not read and no photo URLs were added. The 1931 emergency-station item is a plan, recorded as 'other' rather than built. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced with closed per the trailhead page.
